headlines.headline: WEMBANYAMA POURS IN 43 AS SPURS ROUT TIMBERWOLVES FOR FOURTH STRAIGHT WIN
headlines.detail: San Antonio's Victor Wembanyama scored 43 points with six blocks and seven rebounds in a 121-111 win over Minnesota. Memphis improved to a league-best 6-0 with a 136-105 rout of Sacramento.

headlines.headline: GIANTS LAND J.J. McCARTHY IN TRADE WITH VIKINGS AFTER DART'S SEASON-ENDING KNEE INJURY
headlines.detail: New York dealt a 2027 fifth-round pick for McCarthy after Jaxson Dart's season-ending knee surgery. Dallas also landed CB Joey Porter Jr. from Pittsburgh ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline.

headlines.headline: UNRANKED USC STUNS NO. 2 OHIO STATE 30-18 AS TRUE FRESHMAN FAHEY'S DEBUT FALLS SHORT
headlines.detail: Luke Fahey went 21-of-38 for 260 yards and a TD in his first start, but Ohio State went 2-of-10 in the red zone in the week's biggest upset. Buckeyes drop outside the top 10 ahead of Tuesday's first CFP rankings.

headlines.headline: DIVISION I SEASON TIPS OFF MONDAY WITH NO. 1 FLORIDA HOSTING MIAMI, REIGNING CHAMP MICHIGAN ON THE ROAD
headlines.detail: Florida opens its title bid in Tampa; Michigan, unranked inside the top 15 after Dusty May's exit, opens on the road. Washington hosts Colgate the same night; Champions Classic follows Nov. 10 in Chicago.
